question: Do the complementary perturbation corpora identified in the resource audit cover the 300-target 2026 panel and its 18,533-gene axis?

method.x_atlas: Downloaded HF datasets-server parquet conversions of the cells.lance metadata (HCT116 250 MB, HEK293T 260 MB) and genes.lance (1.7 MB); counted gene_target occurrences against the 300 panel targets and gene_id against the 18,533 panel genes. No expression data downloaded.
method.cd4: Downloaded the 7.3 MB DE_stats.suppl_table.csv from the Marson 2025 S3 bucket; counted target_contrast_gene_name against the panel and applied the publisher quality flags used by the kaipengm2 prepare step (ontarget_significant, >=2 guides, not single_guide_estimate, not distal_offtarget_flag, not low_target_gex).
method.h1_2025: Downloaded pert_counts_Training.csv (2.8 KB) from the Arc 2025 bucket; intersected target_gene with the panel.
method.k562_gwps: Known from prior work: Replogle K562 genome-wide arm covers 272/300 panel targets.

xatlas_HCT116.axis_note: gene_id uses gene symbols; the 427 unmatched panel labels are mostly uncharacterized AC*/lncRNA loci

h1_2025_train.note: too sparse for direct deltas; still useful as a transfer-learning corpus for hESC-like context C

conclusions: The coverage objection that killed the essential-screen route (0/300) does NOT apply: X-Atlas HCT116 and HEK293T each cover all 300 panel targets genome-wide, with >=140 median cells per perturbation.

A 4-lineage consensus ensemble (K562 GWPS 272 + HCT116 300 + HEK293T 300 + CD4 291) could supply at least 3 independent lineage measurements for ~270+ panel targets - the denoising premise of the kaipengm2-style pipeline is data-feasible.
CD4 adds an immune lineage (relevant to Jurkat-like context A) at 291/300 coverage with 251 quality-passing targets.
X-Atlas gene axis covers 97.7% of the panel gene universe; residual labels are mostly uncharacterized loci.
H1-2025 remains a transfer-learning corpus (13/300 direct coverage), not a direct-delta source.
caveats: Coverage is not transferability: paired47 falsified per-target gating, so consensus must denoise on average rather than select per target.
Lineage distance ordering is unknown for 2026 contexts; HCT116/HEK293T are not closer to the panel contexts than K562 a priori.
Cell counts <50 for ~37 targets per X-Atlas arm mean noisy deltas there even though coverage is nominally complete.
CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 license on X-Atlas - non-commercial share-alike; fine for a competition, flag for any commercial reuse.
Downloading the full SLAF expression data for delta computation is a Modal job (expression.lance is ~5 GB in parquet terms for cells metadata alone; actual expression shards are much larger).
next_step: Gate D option 1: build consensus deltas (multi-lineage weighted mean, common-response centering) and evaluate through the k022 diagnostic harness offline before any submission.
